name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingWanted.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of one complete guarded wanted reporter
natural_language_statement:
Let finite decidable index types carry finite sets A,B,C and integer maps $a,b,c$. Fix arithmetic modulus $p\in\mathbb N$, shift $\delta\in\mathbb Z$, block parameters $h,J$, terminal depth $K\le J$ and wanted label $w$ satisfying A membership and its lifted-key congruence. Let $I$ be the original raw-incidence set, $m_0$ its root mass at $w$, and let old cumulative mass $m$ and threshold $\tau$ be stored in the two counter cells. Suppose memory stores both exact source transforms, every catalog through $K$ with its exact metadata and query scratch bounds, original output masks and occurrence row, cover data, original B/C arrays and their correct residue buckets. All retained data, counter, packed rows and frontier slots satisfy the stated ordered bounds before child and terminal scratch. Require the explicit child/query/terminal capacities and work bounds; all address, signed-value, original target-sum and pair-count bounds; the guard sum $m+m_0+\tau+2$ fitting a word; and depth sufficient for $K$, twice global width, terminal frontier length, terminal candidate count and twenty-seven overhead calls.

The fixed reporter packs the query, initializes the frontier, applies the cumulative guard and, if needed, traverses to depth $K$ and tests original values. It returns

$$r\in\{0,1\},\qquad r=1\iff \tau<m+m_0\ \lor\ \exists u\in\operatorname{frontier}(I,w,K):\operatorname{TerminalHit}(u).$$

It sets the cumulative counter to $m+m_0$, meets its specified actual execution budget and preserves all cells below the packed-row base except that counter.

This is the full executed wanted-label contract connecting early dense stopping and exact terminal reporting.
explanation: This is the full executed wanted-label contract connecting early dense stopping and exact terminal reporting.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingHost.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of the complete shared reporting catalog bank
natural_language_statement:
Let original maps $f_B,f_C:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, lengths $N_B,N_C$, band size $g$, parameters $h,J$, arithmetic and source moduli $p,m$, and shift $\delta$ be given. Suppose memory stores the exact source-control record with cutoff $2hJ$, paired original buckets and all corresponding source banks; occurrence rows end before their bank header, and controls, paired header and complete source-bank payload end before free address $f$. Assume addresses fit words and the shared-host resource contract: its full space fits, control/span/power/local-pair/switch-depth values fit words, depth $d+464h+4$ is allowed, and every source-pair row meets its exact level-loop word/space/depth requirements at depth $d+3$. The fixed host constructs the complete retained shared reporting bank for all occurrences and independent band pairs, returns its exact finish address, meets its specified time and preserves every memory cell below $f$.

This realizes the reusable catalogs once per source pair so subsequent wanted queries use retained data.
explanation: This realizes the reusable catalogs once per source pair so subsequent wanted queries use retained data.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorWantedSources.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of cover, guarded wanted records and all original sources
natural_language_statement:
Let $n>0$, positive arithmetic modulus $p$, nonzero guarded modulus $M$, original class lists $A_0,B_0,C_0$ of lengths at most $n$, and their same strictly increasing normalized witnesses A,B,C be given. Suppose memory satisfies the complete normalization/owner/A-incidence contract and stores the signed A-incidence list $X$ bounded by $U$; original B/C values are also bounded by $U$. All original and normalized arrays, band tables, owner records and full incidence-catalog reservations end before free base $f$. Assume addresses fit words and the complete source-constructor space, word and depth budgets fit. The fixed program constructs the local cover and keys, all three guarded A lifts, balanced physical wanted pairs and every reusable original B/C source bank, while retaining the exact normalized witnesses. If $W$ is its returned physical wanted count and $N_q$ the global-key count, it also establishes

$$M W\le3|X|N_q.$$

It returns the source finish address, meets its stated time and preserves memory below $f$.

This is the complete original-data preprocessing path before shared reporting, with wanted mass bounded by the executed common offset.
explanation: This is the complete original-data preprocessing path before shared reporting, with wanted mass bounded by the executed common offset.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingWantedRecord.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of one owner-specific physical wanted record
natural_language_statement:
Let $w$ be a wanted label from the owner-labeled A-incidence domain of physical records $R$, original value maps $f_A,f_B,f_C$, lengths $n,N_B,N_C$, positive band size $g$ and modulus $p$, and parameters $h,J$ be given. Its owner B/C band indices are in range; a valid physical output index decodes to exactly $w$’s global output; $4p$ is at most the encoding modulus; and the lifted A-key congruence holds. Let $K$ be no larger than both the prescribed switch depth and $J$. Suppose memory retains the exact paired buckets, source banks, cover and shared catalogs, selected-control record, computed scratch layout and decoded wanted record. Counter cells precede the layout and store old mass $m$ and threshold $\tau$. Require the exact source-end, bank/report-end, buffer and per-level query-scratch contracts; record-loading space, selected-control word bounds, guard-word bound, terminal-word bound, original-value/target-sum/pair-count bounds and full wanted-depth bound.

Writing $I_w$ for this owner’s original raw-incidence domain and $m_w$ its root mass, the fixed packed-record call returns

$$r\in\{0,1\},\qquad r=1\iff\tau<m+m_w\ \lor\operatorname{Terminal}_K(w).$$

It sets the counter to $m+m_w$, meets the exact owner-specific wanted time plus $4000$, and preserves every cell below the packed-query base except that counter.

This specializes the generic reporter to the actual physical owner/source selection while preserving original-domain semantics.
explanation: This specializes the generic reporter to the actual physical owner/source selection while preserving original-domain semantics.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumReportingSetupBank.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of shared-bank setup from the retained selected-color payload
natural_language_statement:
Let input size $n$, magnitude bound $U$, free selected-color base $f$, parameter-header base $a$, index coloring, original input $x$ and the same strictly increasing normalized lists A,B,C be given. Suppose memory holds their complete encoded-color payload and exact nineteen-field parameter record, with $a+19\le f$. Assume the shared-bank procedure need at its derived report base is admissible for the run limits at depth $d+1$: its word requirement fits, additional cells fit from that base, addresses fit words and its call depth is available. The fixed setup program constructs the exact shared catalog bank, returns the subsequent dense-counter address, retains the complete encoded-color payload and meets its prescribed $n$-dependent time. Every cell below the report base is preserved.

This composes source preprocessing with actual shared reporting initialization using the same normalized witnesses.
explanation: This composes source preprocessing with actual shared reporting initialization using the same normalized witnesses.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorPipeline.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of the complete selected-color preprocessing pipeline
natural_language_statement:
Let $n>0$, original integer input $x:\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to\mathbb Z$ with $|x_i|\le U$, and an index-coloring parameter of width $\operatorname{inputBits}(n)+1$ be given. Suppose memory stores the original input, the exact nineteen-field parameter header and six-field coloring row, all ending before free base $f$. Assume the scheduled radix is at least four, addresses fit words and the pipeline’s full space, word and depth requirements fit. Then the fixed 256-procedure selected-color pipeline constructs its complete output contract: the same normalized A/B/C witnesses, original owner/incidence catalog, prime-chain data, cover, balanced wanted records, original A-key lifts and reusable source banks. It returns the computed result-header address within its prescribed complete pipeline time, preserving every cell below $f$.

This proves the full original-input-to-reporting-data execution for one coloring before the outer deterministic 3SUM decision composition.
explanation: This proves the full original-input-to-reporting-data execution for one coloring before the outer deterministic 3SUM decision composition.
